1789286909_kr.jpg.description: A comfortable medium-sized Indian kitchen designed for easy cooking, organized storage, and good ventilation. The U-shaped layout keeps the refrigerator, sink, preparation counter, and stove within easy reach, while overhead cabinets and open shelves provide plenty of storage without clutter. A large, ventilated window, exhaust fan, chimney, and ceiling fan help move heat and cooking fumes out of the space.
